title: Connect Trendhopper to the MCKey blog
description: Point a Trendhopper webhook at MCKey so published drafts become posts on this site — with RSS and sitemap ready for SEO.
author: MCKey
html:
MCKey's marketing site ships a real blog at /blog, an RSS feed, and a sitemap so Trendhopper (and search engines) can discover posts.

What Trendhopper sends

On publish, Trendhopper POSTs a signed JSON body (event post.published or post.updated) with roughly:

{
  "event": "post.published",
  "id": 123,
  "title": "Your post title",
  "content": "<p>HTML body…</p>",
  "feature_image": "https://…",
  "status": "published",
  "meta_description": "…"
}

Headers include X-Trendhopper-Event and X-Trendhopper-Signature (t=…,v1=… HMAC).

Wire it up

  1. Deploy MCKey to Vercel (API routes need a Node host — GitHub Pages is static-only).
  2. In Trendhopper → Integrations → Webhook, set URL to https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/trendhopper.
  3. Copy the signing secret into Vercel env TRENDHOPPER_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
  4. Optional: set GITHUB_TOKEN + GITHUB_REPO=sterno874/mckey so accepted posts are committed under content/blog/ and Pages/Vercel redeploy.

Connection tests send event ping — we answer 200 without creating a post.

Without the API

You can still drop JSON files into content/blog/ manually or from CI. RSS at /rss.xml updates on the next build.
